headline: 苏茜·怀尔斯不再担任白宫办公厅主任
summary: 美国白宫11月6日发布：特朗普当天宣布任命斯蒂芬·米勒为第33任白宫办公厅主任，接替苏茜·怀尔斯。怀尔斯11月5日晚递交辞呈，11月6日在社交媒体上说当天是她担任白宫办公厅主任的最后一天；特朗普称她将转到特朗普政治团队，职务未公布。白宫妇女健康工作组按2026年10月19日行政令第3条由白宫办公厅主任按职务共同主持，怀尔斯卸任办公厅主任即不再担任共同主席。其他现职未查到。

sources.title: President Trump Names Stephen Miller as 33rd White House Chief of Staff
sources.excerpt: Today, President Donald J. Trump announced the appointment of Stephen Miller as the 33rd White House Chief of Staff, succeeding Susie Wiles after her highly successful tenure.

sources.title: Advancing Women’s Health to Improve Outcomes in All Phases of Life
sources.excerpt: There is hereby established the White House Women’s Health Task Force (Task Force) co-chaired by the Secretary of Health and Human Services and the Assistant to the President and Chief of Staff.
